summary_1line: Ravana convenes his court about Sita and the approaching threat of Rama, while Kumbhakarna rebukes his rash abduction yet vows to fight for him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana sits resplendent on his throne amid richly adorned titans in a perfumed hall, all eyes fixed upon their ten‑headed king.
The gigantic Kumbhakarna rises in fury in the royal assembly, rebuking Ravana for abducting Sita while courtiers look on.
Kumbhakarna boasts of entering battle like a living mountain, roaring and brandishing an immense mace against Rama’s forces.
